items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Wes Montgomery; Interviewee response is inaudible/no substantive content provided.

ctx.x: I heard an interesting story about Wes Montgomery. When Wes made his recordings in the sixties with Don Sebesky, it got to a point that Wes-- apparentlyonce they got him in the studio they tried to do the recording there with string players and woodwind players, and he was just so intimidated by the whole process they eventually just had him come in with the rhythm section and laid down his tracks, and then Sebesky would write the padding around it.
